profile.identity.empty_lede: Tell SelfChronicle who you are — name, where you live, how to reach you.
profile.identity.empty_hint: Import a source or add facts, or fill in your identity once here. Nothing is bundled with the app.

welcome.title: Welcome to your vault
welcome.privacy_extra: Nothing is scraped in the background. You choose what to import, review it, then commit to this device.
welcome.outlets_body: Pick one outlet to bootstrap your vault. Each import is reviewable and provisional — nothing runs silently.
welcome.outlet_github_benefit: One-tap fetch for a public username (profile, repos, languages).
welcome.outlet_linkslander_benefit: Save a site URL you provide as a provisional pointer (no scraping).
welcome.outlet_drive_benefit: Import a vault pack JSON you exported or saved in Drive.
welcome.outlet_chatgpt_benefit: Paste an export JSON to turn chats into Evidence.
welcome.outlet_paste_benefit: Drop any note or export text — review, then commit.
welcome.drive_honest: Sign in with Google to restore your vault from Drive, or upload a pack JSON file below. Your profile follows your Google account across devices.
welcome.drive_upload: Upload pack JSON from Drive / Files
welcome.paste_hint: Paste the export below, then parse. Nothing is uploaded off this device.
welcome.enrich_linked_label: Enrich from linked public pages (IMDb, etc.)
welcome.enrich_linked_hint: Fetches URLs you already listed — not silent scraping. May fail in-browser (CORS); IMDb links still infer Actor offline.
welcome.provisional: All items are provisional. Edit freely after commit.
welcome.done_body: Your public profile pack is in the vault.
welcome.import_hint: Add more anytime from Vault → Import (paste, ChatGPT JSON, or GitHub again).
trust.privacy_body: SelfChronicle is local-first. Your vault stays on this device. No telemetry by default. Imports are user-initiated only.
first_run.title: Welcome to your vault
first_run.body: Notes are plain Markdown with YAML frontmatter you can open in any editor.
dayclose.q2: What do you want to remember?

drive.title: Google Drive sync
drive.body: Your vault profile is keyed to your Google account. Save and restore the vault pack to sync across devices.
drive.not_configured: Drive sync is not configured in this build.
drive.setup_1: Open Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials.
drive.setup_2: Create an OAuth 2.0 Web client and enable the Google Drive API.
drive.setup_3: Add authorized JavaScript origins: http://localhost:5173, capacitor://localhost, https://localhost.
drive.setup_4: Copy examples/web/.env.example to .env.local and set VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID to your client id.
drive.setup_5: Rebuild the web bundle and Android APK, then reinstall on your device.
drive.sync_now_hint: Sign in with Google, merge local vault with Drive, and upload SelfChronicle/vault-pack.json.
drive.cleartext_todo: Provisional cleartext pack on Drive — encryption TODO per PRIVACY.md.
drive.merge_note: All imports share one vault. Sources are provenance tags only. Sync merges by evidence id — newer wins; nothing deleted silently.
morality.title: What matters to you
morality.lede: How you describe what matters to you — priorities you endorse, not a score.
morality.disclaimer: Provisional priorities you can edit. Not a morality score or judgment.
cognition.title: Attention & cognitive style
cognition.disclaimer: Bands and preferences only — not an IQ score, ADHD claim, or clinical assessment.
companion.ai_disclosure: I am an AI companion in SelfChronicle — helpful, not a human substitute.
companion.no_loneliness: SelfChronicle never claims it will be lonely without you.
